headline: UK digital bank says its agentic investigator can work in 17 seconds
body: Starling, a UK digital bank, says it has deployed an agentic "financial crime investigator" that can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds.
note: For fincrime teams, the speed claim is the number to test before anyone repeats it.
